title: Grok patterns
delete_confirmation:
Really delete the grok pattern {{name}}?
It will be removed from the system and unavailable for any extractor. If it is still in use by extractors those will fail to work.
description: This is a list of grok patterns you can use in your grok extractors. You can add your own manually or import a whole list of patterns from a so called pattern file.
no_data: No grok patterns have been found.
error_name_exists: Pattern with that name already exists!
error_test_missing: To test the pattern a name and a pattern must be given!
input_name_help: Under this name the pattern will be stored and can be used like: '%{THISNAME}' later on
input_sample_data_help: Here you can add sample data to test your pattern
input_test_result_help: Will contain the result of your test in a JSON format
input_file_help: A file containing Grok patterns, one per line. Name and patterns should be separated by whitespace.
import_strategy_abort: Abort import if a pattern with the same name already exists
import_strategy_replace: Replace existing patterns with the same name
import_strategy_drop: Drop all existing patterns before import
input_pattern_help: The pattern which will match the log line e.g: '%{IP:client}' or '.*?'
query_helper_field_pattern: The pattern of the grok pattern
query_helper_example: Find grok patterns containing COMMON in the pattern:
